test_snapshot: test the snapshot function that captures a single measurement of optimizer updates and stores it in state
test_monitor: test the monitor function that captures multiple stateful measurements of optimizer updates in a chain
test_measure_with_ema: test measure_with_ema function that records measurements with exponential moving average and optional debiasing
create_snapshot_measurement: create a snapshot measurement to capture the global norm of updates before clipping in an optimizer chain
create_monitor_with_ema: create a monitor with measure_with_ema to track exponential moving average of update norms across training steps
